item.title: Ethereum Launches Platåberget Testnet Ahead of Glamsterdam
item.summary: Ethereum has launched the Platåberget testnet as a temporary testing environment ahead of the network’s planned Glamsterdam upgrade. The network is expected to operate for several months, giving developers, validators and infrastructure providers time to evaluate changes affecting both Ethereum’s consensus and execution layers.
